name: Luan Official Sounds
description: Procedurally synthesized sound packs made for Luan, ready to preview and use in the app.

zh-Hans.name: Luan 官方音效
zh-Hans.description: Luan 官方出品的程序合成音效包，可在 Luan 中直接试听和选用。

packs.name: Analog
packs.description: Warm, full synth phrases with subtle natural movement.

zh-Hans.name: 模拟
zh-Hans.description: 温暖厚实的合成器短句，带细微的自然起伏。

packs.name: Blackbird flute
packs.description: Original synthesized birdsong: flowing, flute-like glides and irregular phrases evoking a blackbird.

zh-Hans.name: 乌鸫·笛语
zh-Hans.description: 原创合成仿鸟鸣：流动的笛质滑音与不规则短句，取乌鸫式歌声意象。

packs.name: Breeze
packs.description: Rounded airflow and soft whistle tones that rise and fall.

zh-Hans.name: 微风
zh-Hans.description: 圆润气流与轻哨管的起落。

packs.name: Clockwork
packs.description: Restrained escapement ticks, winding and light spring sounds.

zh-Hans.name: 钟表
zh-Hans.description: 克制的擒纵滴答、上弦与弹簧轻响。

packs.name: Console
packs.description: Clean, short retro button presses, light with a clear rhythm.

zh-Hans.name: 掌机
zh-Hans.description: 干净短促的复古按键，轻巧而有明确节奏。

packs.name: Copper
packs.description: Small copper bells with body; metallic overtones that fade quickly.

zh-Hans.name: 铜铃
zh-Hans.description: 有厚度的小铜铃，金属泛音迅速收束。

packs.name: Crystal
packs.description: Light, bright glass pulses with subtle beating and clean, clear tails.

zh-Hans.name: 晶光
zh-Hans.description: 轻亮玻璃脉冲与细微拍频，尾音干净透明。

packs.name: Clear cuckoo
packs.description: Original synthesized birdsong: a close, round two-note falling cuckoo call with light breath and a soft throat.

zh-Hans.name: 布谷·清鸣
zh-Hans.description: 原创合成仿鸟鸣：近处、圆润的布谷双音下行，带轻气息与柔和喉腔。

packs.name: Grove cuckoo
packs.description: Original synthesized birdsong: a tighter two-note cuckoo call with richer throat overtones and short woodland reflections.

zh-Hans.name: 布谷·林间
zh-Hans.description: 原创合成仿鸟鸣：较紧凑的布谷双音，稍厚的喉腔泛音与林间短反射。

packs.name: Misty cuckoo
packs.description: Original synthesized birdsong: a lower, slower two-note cuckoo call; softened highs and a short tail give a sense of distance in morning mist.

zh-Hans.name: 布谷·晨雾
zh-Hans.description: 原创合成仿鸟鸣：较低、较缓的布谷双呼，柔化高频与短余韵营造晨雾距离感。

packs.name: Gentle dove
packs.description: Original synthesized birdsong: a low, soft coo with a gentle attack and light throat trill, suited to quiet work.

zh-Hans.name: 斑鸠·低吟
zh-Hans.description: 原创合成仿鸟鸣：低柔的 coo 声腔、缓起音与轻喉颤，适合安静工作提示。

packs.name: Feather
packs.description: Warm synthesized birdsong with light breath and midrange resonance; glide direction and phrase rhythm tell events apart.

zh-Hans.name: 鸾羽
zh-Hans.description: 温润的合成鸟鸣、轻气息与中频共鸣；用滑音方向和短句节奏区分事件。

packs.name: Felt
packs.description: Warm, round tones from soft felt mallets that start gently without dragging.

zh-Hans.name: 毡音
zh-Hans.description: 柔软毡槌的温暖圆音，缓起而不拖沓。

packs.name: FM Keys
packs.description: Electric piano keys with a touch of glassiness and a bright, clean finish.

zh-Hans.name: 数码琴
zh-Hans.description: 带一点玻璃质感的电子琴键，清亮收束。

packs.name: Kalimba
packs.description: Short plucks and warm tines with a hint of wooden body.

zh-Hans.name: 拇指琴
zh-Hans.description: 短拨片和温暖簧片，保留轻微木腔感。

packs.name: Marimba
packs.description: Warm, harmonic wooden bars and soft mallet rolls.

zh-Hans.name: 木琴
zh-Hans.description: 温暖谐波木条与柔槌滚奏。

packs.name: Neon
packs.description: Crisp, lively electronic plucks with a bouncy sheen.

zh-Hans.name: 霓虹
zh-Hans.description: 明快利落的电子拨音，带一点跳跃的光泽。

packs.name: Orbit
packs.description: Rounded electronic pulses with brief spatial resonance.

zh-Hans.name: 星环
zh-Hans.description: 圆润电子脉冲与短暂空间共鸣。

packs.name: Paper
packs.description: Grains like folding paper and turning pages, with a little low end under short rustles.

zh-Hans.name: 纸间
zh-Hans.description: 折纸与翻页般的颗粒，少量低音托住短促摩擦。

packs.name: Pebble
packs.description: Short, dry stone clicks with a light bounce.

zh-Hans.name: 卵石
zh-Hans.description: 短促干燥的石击与轻回弹。

packs.name: Plucked
packs.description: Fine plucked-string overtones muted by a fingertip.

zh-Hans.name: 弦语
zh-Hans.description: 细密拨弦泛音与指腹止音。

packs.name: Porcelain
packs.description: Clear, soft porcelain resonance and light taps.

zh-Hans.name: 瓷响
zh-Hans.description: 清透柔和的瓷质共鸣与轻敲。

packs.name: Raindrop
packs.description: Round falling water drops with brief glides and tiny ripples.

zh-Hans.name: 雨滴
zh-Hans.description: 圆润水珠落下，带短暂滑音与细小水纹。

packs.name: Satellite
packs.description: Distant, airy blips that leave a soft echo.

zh-Hans.name: 卫星
zh-Hans.description: 有距离感的空灵点声，留下轻轻的回响。

packs.name: Telemetry
packs.description: Sparse electronic blips, like small replies from a quiet instrument panel.

zh-Hans.name: 遥测
zh-Hans.description: 疏落的电子点声，像安静仪表上的小小回应。

packs.name: Velvet
packs.description: Soft, round short chords for when you would rather not be interrupted.

zh-Hans.name: 丝绒
zh-Hans.description: 柔软圆润的短和声，适合不想被打断的时候。

packs.name: Willow warbler
packs.description: Original synthesized birdsong: short, soft, curving trills with restrained vibrato evoking a willow warbler.

zh-Hans.name: 柳莺·轻啭
zh-Hans.description: 原创合成仿鸟鸣：短而柔的曲线轻啭，用克制的颤动表达柳莺意象。

packs.name: Water Mirror
packs.description: Soft inharmonic resonance, like a water surface slowly spreading.

zh-Hans.name: 水镜
zh-Hans.description: 柔和非谐波共鸣，像水面缓慢展开。

packs.name: Wood
packs.description: Dry, warm wooden plucks and short knocks.

zh-Hans.name: 木语
zh-Hans.description: 干燥温暖的木质拨奏与短敲。
